attributes.name: Diviner's Blight
attributes.powers:
When a character is chosen randomly, recharge this card before the choice is made; if you would be chosen, another character is chosen randomly instead.

When you discard this card as damage, it counts as up to 4 cards. If proficient with light armors, after discarding, you may draw 1 or 2 cards.

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
